issues.description: Deprecation message duplicates info already in the docstring directive.
issues.detail: The runtime warning string and the .. deprecated:: 4.3 directive say the same thing twice. Fine, not worth blocking. Minor nit: 'stlib' typo in the docstring should be 'stdlib'. Fix the typo, leave the rest alone.

issues.description: Test asserts only on the tail of the deprecation message.
issues.detail: The pytest.warns match pattern only checks the 'Please use...' suffix. If someone rewords the prefix, the test still passes silently. Not wrong, just sloppy. Match on something stable like 'deprecated' or the function name if you care.

review.summary: Small, scoped, one-thing patch. Adds a deprecation decorator, updates internal callers, adds a news fragment and a test that actually exercises the warning. This is what a patch should look like: it does one thing, the diff is readable, it matches surrounding style, and the maintainer-six-years-from-now will not curse the author. Two nits worth fixing in passing: 'stlib' typo and a loose warning-message match in the test. ACCEPT with trivial fixup.
